hypothesis: Magnetic horizontal-gradient crests (Blakely & Simpson 1986 edge estimator on TMI) that also sit in above-median geodetic second-invariant strain rate mark buried or unmapped fault traces that are absent from the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue.
mechanism: A fault with vertical or steep offset juxtaposes magnetically contrasting blocks, producing a narrow horizontal-gradient crest; active slip concentrates geodetic strain in the same corridor.
named_non_fault_mimic: Lithologic or intrusive contacts (magnetic crests without slip) and GPS/InSAR network-geometry strain artefacts near survey edges.
